metadata.description: Cross-domain thinking, multi-model tooling, and developer productivity plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: distill
plugins.description: Iteratively decompose complex systems into their essential primitives.

plugins.name: lateral-thinking
plugins.description: Generate non-obvious hypotheses by decomposing a problem to its mechanism and raiding distant fields.

plugins.name: codex-exec
plugins.description: Run the Codex CLI for non-interactive coding work. Second opinions, adversarial review, and multi-model consensus.

plugins.name: composer
plugins.description: Run Cursor Composer as a planner-led implementation or review worker without the Pi harness.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Engineering-practice workflows under /engineering:* commands, including TDD, architecture, defined terms, and read-only complexity reports.

plugins.name: bun-expert
plugins.description: Expert guidance for JavaScript/TypeScript development with the Bun runtime. Covers setup, servers, APIs, testing, bundling, and Node.js migration.

plugins.name: claude
plugins.description: Run Claude Code CLI with tmux-backed TUI delegation, session continuation, manual takeover, and non-interactive fallback.

plugins.name: cli-design-expert
plugins.description: Design or review command-line interfaces for usability and automation: help text, flags, exit codes, TTY behavior.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Grouped coding workflows under /code:* commands. prepare-pr is full PR readiness through commit, push, and PR update; review-and-commit is quick local review plus commit.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Agent harness workflows for repository environments that expose progressive docs, glossary terms, todo specs, validation routes, design guidance, and domain invariants to coding agents.

plugins.name: decision-worksheet
plugins.description: Inventory every item in a scope from real evidence, then build one self-contained HTML worksheet to ratify or override a recommended verdict per item and return the decisions.

plugins.name: capture-feedback
plugins.description: Capture concise user corrections about agent behavior into a local shared inbox for later trace review and skill or rule improvements.

plugins.name: hexagon-audit
plugins.description: Audit Ports & Adapters (Hexagonal Architecture) compliance in a packages/ + adapters/ monorepo, with a deterministic scanner for inward-dependency violations, peer-adapter imports, and vendor SDKs leaking into ports.

plugins.name: human-writer
plugins.description: Edit prose so it sounds natural, specific, and human-written. Use when a draft feels generic or model-generated.

plugins.name: improve-prompt
plugins.description: Improve vague or underspecified prompts into sharp, reusable prompts for planning, coding, review, decision, and handoff work.

plugins.name: pi
plugins.description: Claude-native planner/generator/evaluator harness with UI layout planning, screenshot-backed review, and structured debate.

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description: Generate a self-contained HTML visualization in an ivory/clay editorial gallery style for systems, plans, code flows, and concepts.
